**Jennifer Saviano, ABC’s The Bachelor & Bachelor in Paradise**

I recently completed my series of three UltraVision™ treatments and am thrilled with the results. I
am in my 60s but feel like my face makes me look closer to 40. As someone who has tried several
topical products and a few treatments, UltraVision™ is the one that has the most value and impact.

before, I thought I knew what to expect from the treatment, but this treatment was different. First,

A Clinical Approach To Modern Skin Health

We are defining a more clinical, outcomes-driven approach to skin health, enabling providers to
deliver high-quality, proven results with greater consistency. As skin health becomes a core part of
modern lifestyle, we are shaping how it is delivered and experienced in treatment rooms around the
world.

Corporate Profile

SkinHealth Systems is a global medical aesthetics company delivering an integrated ecosystem of
clinically proven solutions designed to help consumers achieve superior skin health and support the
success of providers. Anchored by Hydrafacial™, a leading and widely requested professional skincare
treatment, and supported by complementary offerings including SkinStylus™ microneedling and
HydraScalp™ with Keravive™, SkinHealth Systems combines advanced device technology, proprietary
consumables, and clinical validation to deliver trusted treatment experiences through an omnichannel
network of providers worldwide.

## CLINICCARE Peels

The CLINICCARE (second generation) Peel range is effective in treating hyperpigmentation, age spots
and sun damage; anti-ageing and skin rejuvenation; acne treatment and the improvement of skin
texture.

[Discover the range][142]

[Alyval]

## Intimate Care

Alyval is an award-winning intimate wellbeing range specially formulated to provide gentle,
effective daily comfort and targeted support. Designed to hydrate, rejuvenate, protect, and restore.
Relieving symptoms and helping to maintain natural balance.

[Discover the range][143]

# Advanced Aesthetics

Professional Aesthetic and Multi-Technology Devices. Radio Frequency, Electroporation, Electrical
Muscle Stimulation and Iontophoresis, Dr Platon Cold Plasma and LED Cube Lights.

[Find out more][144]

[[Codex and Raffine]][145]

## Microneedling

Automatic microneedle therapy systems, effective for the non-surgical and non-ablative treatment of
various skin conditions including ageing, scarring and hyperpigmentation.

[Find out more][146]

[Lumixa Logo ]

NEW Patented Technology

worry about the appearance of my face or having to schedule “down time”. The second difference from
previous treatments is that within two weeks of my first treatment, I noticed a difference: several
of my lines/wrinkles, especially my laugh lines, were not as deep. I could easily see the
improvement in the mirror. I recently was at my hairdresser who asked me what I had been doing, as
she, too, noticed my skin’s improvement. The treatment itself was painless, although you can
definitely feel it. All in all, I’m very happy with the results.

**- Debra P., 67 years old**

## It’s not the new you. It’s the renewed you.

SkinPen microneedling helps uncover the true you by naturally renewing your skin from within to
restore a smoother, more radiant complexion. By enhancing your skin’s natural beauty, you can have
the confidence to let the world see the fierce, beautiful soul within.

[ About SkinPen *About SkinPen*][9]

## Behind the Seens
## with SkinPen

Real patients. Real confidence. SkinPen isn’t just about skin, it’s about transformation. Meet real
patients who turned to SkinPen during life’s biggest moments and walked away with more than just
results—they found confidence they never thought possible. In **Behind the Seens** with SkinPen,
real people share the moments that led them to SkinPen — and the results that changed everything.

Go behind the seens.


[ Watch now *Watch now*][10]

  Results are natural^{*}, safe, and effective for all skin tones and types
  
  *Results are generated by your body's natural wound healing process.

* 03
  
  Quick-and-easy, year-round option with little to no downtime
* 04
  
  Dramatically improves the appearance of acne scars^{¹}
* 05
  
  Significantly improves the appearance of wrinkles on the neck^{¹}
* 06

## Meet Dr. Don Mehrabi, MD, FAAD

Dr. Don Mehrabi is a board-certified dermatologist and leader in the Los Angeles dermatology field,
recognized for his expertise and compassionate care. With top honors from Kent State University and
Northeastern Ohio Universities College of Medicine, Dr. Mehrabi’s training includes a dermatology
residency at Texas Southwestern Medical Center and a subspecialty certification in Micrographic
Dermatologic Surgery. Named among LA’s Top Doctors and America’s Most Honored Professionals, he
excels in providing personalized care, addressing medical, cosmetic, and surgical dermatology needs
with precision and empathy.

From acne treatment and Mohs surgery to Botox and laser dermatology, Dr. Mehrabi offers a
comprehensive range of services at his Encino and Glendale locations, with virtual consultations
also available. His dedication to patient-centered care and clear communication makes him a trusted
partner in achieving healthy, beautiful skin.

# Just Find Skin Care That Works For You

Welcome to The Skincare Company Spa & Salon. We are a Full Service Spa and Hair Salon located in the
River Forest, Forest Park, Oak Park IL area. We are located within 5-15 minutes of the following
locations: Chicago, Melrose Park, Elmwood Park, Brookfield IL, Riverside, La Grange IL and Berwyn.
Our friendly staff is fully trained, licensed and certified to give you the best in clinical skin
care and spa treatments.
* We offer Advanced Clinical Skincare treatments designed to target and address a variety of skin
  concerns, including anti-aging, hyperpigmentation, acne, and more.
* Advanced, clinical skin care with a friendly staff is fully trained, licensed and certified to
  give you the best in clinical skin care and spa treatments.
* Treatments include advanced procedures such as chemical peels, microneedling, and customized
  facials tailored to your specific skin needs.
* We combine science-backed ingredients and techniques to enhance skin health while focusing on
  improving texture, tone, and overall radiance.

The spicules used in SQT® penetrate the skin 20-30% deeper than traditional microneedling devices,

traditional microneedling sessions.

### Natural and Safe

Since the spicules are extracted from natural freshwater sponges, the treatment is 100% natural and
safe for all skin types.

# Your Guide to Safe, Proven Aesthetic Care

At World’s Leading Clinics, we connect discerning patients with certified providers who combine
artistry, advanced skill, and uncompromising care, delivering results that inspire confidence and
natural beauty. A global standard patients can trust, and clinics aspire to achieve.

[ Find a Provider ][14]
Use my current location
[Search Certified Clinics][15]

What we do

## Overview & Patient Benefits

Every treatment by a World’s Leading Clinics Certified Provider is delivered with advanced
techniques, world-class technology, and uncompromising safety standards. From surgical procedures
performed by board-certified surgeons to non-surgical treatments by certified aesthetic specialists,
every service is personalized to your goals. Compare top providers, explore verified results, and
make confident choices guided by our trusted experts.

[ See All Clinics ][16]

### Transparency

We make your search effortless by showing exactly how each clinic meets our standards. Every
certified clinic lists verified credentials, treatment offerings, and patient feedback, so you can
compare options and choose a provider based on facts, not marketing.

### Integrity over Influence

We are not (and will never be!) pay-to-play. Unlike our competition, clinics cannot buy recognition
or placement on our platform. Every certification is earned through a transparent, evidence-based
evaluation measuring safety, ethics, and patient outcomes. Recognition is a privilege, not a
purchase.

### Independent Evaluation

Our certification process is independent. Clinics undergo in-depth reviews across safety, outcomes,
culture, and patient experience, ensuring only those that meet the world’s highest standards are
recognized.

### Education at the Core

Knowledge empowers confidence. That’s why we created an entire educational library on our site,
featuring treatment guides, concern-based topics, and personal blog posts with expert insights and
videos. It’s designed to help you understand your options, learn from trusted providers, and make
informed decisions about your care.

### Credibility

Our network features board-certified surgeons, physicians, and licensed specialists with verified
training and proven results. Whether you’re exploring plastic surgery or non-surgical rejuvenation,
you can trust your care to experienced professionals known for excellence and natural outcomes.

### Global Standards, Local Excellence

Every clinic in our network is evaluated through the same transparent criteria, ensuring consistent
quality no matter where you are. Whether you’re in Los Angeles or London, you can expect the same
standard of expertise, ethics, and patient-first care.

### You First, Always

Your safety, comfort, and confidence are our top priorities. Each certified clinic upholds the
highest medical and ethical standards, providing care with precision, discretion, and compassion -
the defining traits of the world’s leading practices.

### What is Dr. Pen™ Microneedling?

Doctor Pen derma pen is designed for microneedling, the gentle procedure of making multiple
injections with thin needles into the upper layers of the epidermis. This home procedure provokes
the essential skin renewal and ensures that the serum is absorbed. As a result, you get the radiant
and glowing skin.

### Microneedling: what skin problems will Dr. Pen help to solve?

As we age, we may notice that our skin becomes duller. The reason is that the skin's natural
collagen and elastin production processes slow down. We buy expensive serums - but do they work?
Serum molecules are usually too large to penetrate the deep layers of the skin and produce an
effect. Microneedling solves this problem: with small, painless injections, it affects the deep
layers of the skin - and radiance and youth will not take long to appear!

# Just Find Skin Care That Works For You

Welcome to The Skincare Company Spa & Salon. We are a Full Service Spa and Hair Salon located in the
River Forest, Forest Park, Oak Park IL area. We are located within 5-15 minutes of the following
locations: Chicago, Melrose Park, Elmwood Park, Brookfield IL, Riverside, La Grange IL and Berwyn.
Our friendly staff is fully trained, licensed and certified to give you the best in clinical skin
care and spa treatments.
* We offer Advanced Clinical Skincare treatments designed to target and address a variety of skin
  concerns, including anti-aging, hyperpigmentation, acne, and more.
* Advanced, clinical skin care with a friendly staff is fully trained, licensed and certified to
  give you the best in clinical skin care and spa treatments.
* Treatments include advanced procedures such as chemical peels, microneedling, and customized
  facials tailored to your specific skin needs.
* We combine science-backed ingredients and techniques to enhance skin health while focusing on
  improving texture, tone, and overall radiance.

## Research Facts about SQT®

### Skin Penetration

The spicules used in SQT® penetrate the skin 20-30% deeper than traditional microneedling devices,
enhancing the delivery of active ingredients

### Effectiveness

A single session of SQT® Bio Microneedling can achieve results equivalent to 60-80% of three to five
traditional microneedling sessions.

### Natural and Safe

Since the spicules are extracted from natural freshwater sponges, the treatment is 100% natural and
safe for all skin types.

### Why Telegram?

### Simple

**Telegram** is so simple you already know how to use it.

### Private

**Telegram** messages are heavily encrypted and can self-destruct.

### Synced

**Telegram** lets you access your chats from multiple devices.

### Fast

**Telegram** delivers messages faster than any other application.

### Powerful

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

### Open

**Telegram** has an open [API][40] and source code free for everyone.

### Secure

**Telegram** keeps your messages safe from hacker attacks.

### Social

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

### Expressive

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

##### Telegram

Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with a focus on security and speed.

# Your Guide to Safe, Proven Aesthetic Care

At World’s Leading Clinics, we connect discerning patients with certified providers who combine
artistry, advanced skill, and uncompromising care, delivering results that inspire confidence and
natural beauty. A global standard patients can trust, and clinics aspire to achieve.

[ Find a Provider ][14]
Use my current location
[Search Certified Clinics][15]

What we do

## Overview & Patient Benefits

Every treatment by a World’s Leading Clinics Certified Provider is delivered with advanced
techniques, world-class technology, and uncompromising safety standards. From surgical procedures
performed by board-certified surgeons to non-surgical treatments by certified aesthetic specialists,
every service is personalized to your goals. Compare top providers, explore verified results, and
make confident choices guided by our trusted experts.

[ See All Clinics ][16]

### Transparency

We make your search effortless by showing exactly how each clinic meets our standards. Every
certified clinic lists verified credentials, treatment offerings, and patient feedback, so you can
compare options and choose a provider based on facts, not marketing.

### Integrity over Influence

We are not (and will never be!) pay-to-play. Unlike our competition, clinics cannot buy recognition
or placement on our platform. Every certification is earned through a transparent, evidence-based
evaluation measuring safety, ethics, and patient outcomes. Recognition is a privilege, not a
purchase.

### Independent Evaluation

Our certification process is independent. Clinics undergo in-depth reviews across safety, outcomes,
culture, and patient experience, ensuring only those that meet the world’s highest standards are
recognized.

### Education at the Core

Knowledge empowers confidence. That’s why we created an entire educational library on our site,
featuring treatment guides, concern-based topics, and personal blog posts with expert insights and
videos. It’s designed to help you understand your options, learn from trusted providers, and make
informed decisions about your care.

### Credibility

Our network features board-certified surgeons, physicians, and licensed specialists with verified
training and proven results. Whether you’re exploring plastic surgery or non-surgical rejuvenation,
you can trust your care to experienced professionals known for excellence and natural outcomes.

### Global Standards, Local Excellence

Every clinic in our network is evaluated through the same transparent criteria, ensuring consistent
quality no matter where you are. Whether you’re in Los Angeles or London, you can expect the same
standard of expertise, ethics, and patient-first care.

### You First, Always

Your safety, comfort, and confidence are our top priorities. Each certified clinic upholds the
highest medical and ethical standards, providing care with precision, discretion, and compassion -
the defining traits of the world’s leading practices.

Clinics

Resurrect Skin MD was founded and is led by Dr. A. Jay Burns, a board-certified plastic surgeon with
over 30 years of experience. He personally vets every device and guides individualized treatment
plans, combining rigorous science, advanced technology, and compassionate care to deliver natural,
lasting results at his Dallas-based clinic.

### [AdmireMD Plastic Surgery][22]

AdmireMD Plastic Surgery was founded by Dr. Anthony A. Admire, a board-certified plastic and
reconstructive surgeon recognized for his precision, artistry, and patient-first philosophy. Located
in Scottsdale, Arizona, the practice specializes in facial rejuvenation, body contouring, and breast
enhancement, delivering refined, natural results with uncompromising safety.

### [AesthetiCare Medspa + Wellness][24]

Since opening in 2001, AesthetiCare Medspa + Wellness has grown into one of the Midwest’s most
trusted destinations for advanced skin and body treatments.

### [AboutSkin Dermatology & Aesthetics][26]

AboutSkin Dermatology & Aesthetics is directed by Joel L. Cohen, MD, an internationally recognized
dermatologist, educator, and researcher. He leads a team of board-certified dermatologists dedicated
to combining academic rigor, clinical excellence, and aesthetic innovation. Each treatment plan is
customized, blending medical precision and artistry to deliver safe, lasting results.
